usage.callShape: GET https://laso.finance/auth (no body). Pays $0.001 USDC on Base via x402, OR satisfies the sign-in-with-x (SIWX) extension via wallet identity — in testing SIWX was accepted and the call returned 200 at $0 cost.
usage.outputShape: body.auth.id_token (1h Firebase JWT bearer), body.auth.refresh_token, body.auth.expires_in ("3600"), body.callable_base_url, body.user_id
quirks: REGISTRY URL CORRECTION: the discovery/surface CALL line says GET https://api.laso.finance/x402/rates but that host is NXDOMAIN/dead (HTTP 000). The real, live endpoint is GET https://laso.finance/auth.

This is the AUTH/login step only, not a rates endpoint. It returns a 1h Firebase ID token; you then use auth.id_token as a bearer against callable_base_url (https://us-central1-kyc-ts.cloudfunctions.net) for the actual card operations (order card, balance, withdraw, merchant search).

Endpoint advertises BOTH x402 (Base/Solana USDC, $0.001) and the sign-in-with-x (SIWX) extension. In QA the SIWX path was honored and returned 200 with the token at $0 — no on-chain payment was charged.
id_token expires in 3600s (1h); use auth.refresh_token to renew.
Service is US-only; downstream card operations involve real money (orders cost the card value, $5-$1000) and are irreversible.
usage.guide: Call GET https://laso.finance/auth with no body. The registry's api.laso.finance/x402/rates URL is wrong (dead host) — use laso.finance/auth. The call is gated by x402 ($0.001 USDC on Base) but also accepts the sign-in-with-x (SIWX) extension; in testing SIWX was accepted and it returned 200 for free. Read body.auth.id_token (a 1-hour Firebase JWT) and body.callable_base_url, then send id_token as a bearer token to callable_base_url to perform the real card operations (order/balance/withdraw). This auth step is cheap and safe, but the downstream card-order operations move real money and are irreversible, so require approval before ordering a card.
